kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أستعجب (form X)
# أَسْتَعْجِبُ (ʔastaʕjibu) /ʔas.taʕ.d͡ʒi.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْجَبَ (istaʕjaba)
# أَسْتَعْجِبَ (ʔastaʕjiba) /ʔas.taʕ.d͡ʒi.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَعْجَبَ (istaʕjaba)
# أَسْتَعْجِبْ (ʔastaʕjib) /ʔas.taʕ.d͡ʒib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَعْجَبَ (istaʕjaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
